test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

Sheena said, 'I am flying a kite.'

options.text: Sheena said that she had flown a kite
Sheena said that she has been flying a kite.
Sheena said that she was flying a kite.
Sheena says she was flying a kite.

solution:
The correct answer is 'Sheena said that she was flying a kite.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When converting from direct to reported speech, changes are made to pronouns, verb tense, and time expressions.
 
• The direct speech sentence is: "**Sheena said, 'I am flying a kite.'**"
 
• The pronoun "**I**" changes to "**she**" in reported speech.
 
• The present continuous tense "**am flying**" changes to the past continuous tense "**was flying**" in reported speech.
 
• The correct reported speech sentence is "**Sheena said that she was flying a kite.**"

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct Sentence: *"Sheena said that she was flying a kite."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options are incorrect for the following reasons:
 
• **Option 1: "Sheena said that she had flown a kite."**
 
 
• Reason: This option is incorrect as it changes the tense to past perfect, which is not appropriate here.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: "Sheena said that she has been flying a kite."**
 
 
• Reason: This option is incorrect as it keeps the present perfect continuous tense, which should change to past continuous.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: "Sheena says she was flying a kite."**
 
 
• Reason: This option is incorrect as it changes the reporting verb to the present tense "says" instead of maintaining the past tense "said."
